title: Jagamae Sangeetham
synopsis: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

title: Part-Timers
synopsis: Two roommates, worlds apart, barely stay together. But these two women share one grand dream: a start-up.

title: Aakali Rajyam
synopsis: Three friends, one fresh start, and a life full of unexpected challenges. As job struggles, money problems, and personal battles push them to the edge, can their friendship and a bold new dream change their lives?

title: Panchanama
synopsis: Police officer Jai Ram refuses to accept his brother Aadi's death as an accident. His investigation leads him to reopen other suspicious death cases involving Aadi, Praveen and Joseph, eventually uncovering a much larger conspiracy connected to a medical syndicate.
